scope: Exact whole fans and actual commuting unit-coordinate quotients support a uniform all-field rank-indistinguishability theorem. The family is binomial and has a linear-volume monic carrier box; no supergeneric lower family, unrestricted bound, full mixed-wall budget or novelty is established.

uniform_theorem.same_data: Identical labelled planar column matroids, elimination and colon ideals, planar quotient modulo x, and square-zero x-Jordan type.
uniform_theorem.missing_sign_scope: Every swapped-family wall has nonzero x component and opposite nonzero y,z signs; both controlled coordinate budgets vanish.
uniform_theorem.information_consequence: These marginal data cannot determine the fan or cost. Symmetric approximation requires Omega(n_k^(1/3)) for the count and Omega(n_k^(1/2)) for cost.
